2558-8095-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-8095-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2364-2981-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-2981-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Mana Vault, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

4247-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4247-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4490-7862--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7862--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Citizen V triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7862--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

64-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-851-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4934-5078-7913.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2178-5147-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2595-5686--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4446-4681-5170-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-4681-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2907-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2907-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

967-1308-2511-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

147-2438-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-3875-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-3875-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

104-413-2086.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2-2034-5554-6753.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1651-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing two Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

969-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
969-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1636-2348-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2348-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-2348-5996.description:
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2438-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
2438-3293-5282.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1242-1323-3143-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Forensic Researcher each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-3143-5475.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Forensic Researcher's first ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

2043-2556-3263-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {10}.
2043-2556-3263-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {10}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {4}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {11}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

4050-4516-4871.notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
4050-4516-4871.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1023-1769-2201-2641.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1023-1769-2201-2641.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vengeful Dead and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vengeful Dead trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

141-2596-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2596-5256.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

198-3525-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator does not have summoning sickness.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-3525-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Empowered Autogenerator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by putting a charge counter and tapping it, adding {U} equal to charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
